rules: Do not copy text from the examples — write completely new content.
Do not mention competitors, rankings, search results or the research.
Do not invent payment methods, licences, bonus amounts, withdrawal times, ratings, reviews or legal claims that are not in the examples.
Do not fabricate testimonials, named quotes or absolute promises. The first-person voice of the examples is fine to follow when it carries no claim that cannot be backed.

Inside a sentence write [words](/path) for a link to another page of this site, and **words** for emphasis. Emphasise the subject a paragraph opens on when the paragraph turns to something new, and concrete figures such as stakes and amounts. At most three runs in a block, and not in every paragraph — emphasis everywhere is emphasis nowhere.
Keep the meta title and description accurate and natural, without keyword stuffing.
Do not use the brand name that appears in the examples — write only about the brand you were given.
